about_the_game:
Deep Single-Character Development, the Ultimate Immersive Experience!

Are you, like us, tired of screens filled with three-star, four-star, and five-star character cards? Tired of equipping and assigning skills to every team member? Tired of most companions only being with you for a fleeting moment?

A single character is the soul of idle games! Only a single character can deliver true immersion!

Dozens of attributes + dozens of skills + dozens of talents = endless build combinations! Craft your one-of-a-kind character and write your own legendary story!

Equipment System, So Rich It’s Mind-Blowing!

Cloth armor, leather armor, chainmail, plate armor; swords, spears, axes, halberds, staves, shields, bows, crossbows, jewelry, wings, pets—everything you can imagine!

Whether you’re a fearless warrior clad in heavy armor, a seemingly “frail” mysterious mage, or a thorn-covered, damage-reflecting tank, our vast equipment library always has something for you!

Each piece of gear comes in four rarities: Common, Rare, Epic, and Legendary, with each attribute having a random range. Every equipment slot even has its own unique attribute pool. Think that’s all? Not at all! There are also set bonuses scattered across the continent, waiting for you to collect and unlock their hidden, powerful effects!

Glowing Gear, Power Visible at a Glance!

Should Legendary gear and Common gear only differ when you check their stats? Should reinforcing to +13 just coldly increase numbers?

Absolutely not! In AFKandia, powerful equipment comes with visual impact! Legendary gear literally shines with golden light, making you the most dazzling presence in any crowd!

Crafting System, Forge Your Own Godly Gear!

Nothing is more thrilling than crafting a top-tier piece of equipment from scratch! In AFKandia, rare gems and materials are scattered everywhere. Collect them, and you can craft powerful wings, magical pets, or even one-of-a-kind special gear!

What? Your Legendary plate armor somehow rolled +50 Intelligence? Your weapon’s attribute range is 2-100, but it frustratingly landed on a 2?

Don’t lose hope! Invest a few gems, and there’s a chance it could get stronger… or, well, worse. Do you dare to test your luck?

Collection Fun, Surprises Everywhere!

Is there a point to slaying a thousand goblins? Of course! They might drop rare cards that permanently boost your stats!

Not enough space in your inventory? Collect specific materials to expand it!

Got too many coins with nowhere to spend them? Try your hand at exciting lotteries!

How do you learn skills? Haha, skill books, skill stones, and ancient parchment scrolls dropped by monsters will give you the answers!

Wait, why do these two Fireball skill books have different damage values? Skill damage can be random too?!

Battle Strategy, Show Off Your Skills Even in Idle Mode!

Who says idle games lack strategy? In AFKandia, you can set precise conditions for skill activation: More than 5 monsters on the field? Health below 30%? Cast every 5 seconds? Unleash your tactical brilliance!

Look at that! This Goblin Elite has 3 Swiftness affixes! Its speed is absolutely insane!

Oh no! A Boss Fire Dragon King with (Strengthened), (Fire Enhanced), and (Magic Boosted) affixes? I’m doomed!

More Surprises Await Your Discovery!

Got a top-tier piece of gear you can’t use? No problem! Store it in the shared warehouse—your next character might need it!

Want to share gear with a friend? Easy! Convert it into a mysterious code and send it to your comrade anytime! (Using a special encryption algorithm, no internet required—safe and convenient.)

What Are You Waiting For? Add to Wishlist Now!

AFKandia invites you to embark on an adventure full of strategy, collection, and growth! Forge your unique legend and become the most radiant hero on the continent!
